fact: SARB Directive No. 1 of 2025 directs participants to migrate low-value cross-border EFTs within the Common Monetary Area (incl. Lesotho) from SADC-RTGS to the TCIB payment scheme, ceasing SADC-RTGS use by 31 March 2027 and using TCIB from 1 April 2027.
title: South African Reserve Bank Act: Directive No. 1 of 2025: Execution of low-value cross-border electronic funds transfer within Common Monetary Area
publisher: South African Reserve Bank (Government Gazette No. 52435, General Notice 3106)
